articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in fields like molecular biology and legal analysis.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Models Enable Dexterous Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: Google DeepMind published results from its Gemini-powered robotics foundation model, demonstrating zero-shot generalization to novel household manipulation tasks including folding irregular fabrics and assembling flat-pack furniture components. The system combines a vision-language-action architecture with real-time tactile feedback, achieving a 87% success rate on previously unseen object categories.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Pilot Deployment at Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla began deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot at select partner logistics and warehouse facilities outside its own factories, marking the first commercial pilot with external customers. The robots handle palletizing, bin-picking, and inventory scanning tasks with improved battery life of 10+ hours and enhanced hand dexterity featuring 22 degrees of freedom per hand.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Real-Time Computer Use Agent for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic released a generally available computer-use agent capability for Claude, allowing enterprises to deploy AI agents that can autonomously navigate desktop applications, web interfaces, and internal tools to complete multi-step business workflows. The system includes a new audit-trail framework and human-in-the-loop checkpoints designed for compliance-sensitive industries like finance and healthcare.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Fab 20 facility in Tainan, roughly one quarter ahead of initial projections. The node leverages gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery, offering a 25% performance uplift and 35% power reduction over N2, with AI accelerator and HPC chips among the first customer tape-outs.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth Open-Weight Model with 2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the full open-weight version of Llama 4 Behemoth, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that rivals proprietary frontier systems on reasoning, code generation, and multilingual benchmarks. The release includes quantized variants optimized for multi-GPU inference on consumer-accessible hardware, and a new permissive license allowing commercial use without revenue thresholds.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink obtained FDA clearance to begin clinical trials of its N2 implant, which features 4,096 electrode channels — quadruple the first-generation device — and wireless charging, eliminating the need for surgical battery replacement. Early data from the initial BCI cohort showed participants achieving typing speeds exceeding 30 words per minute through thought alone, raising both excitement and ethical scrutiny.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction Sites
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, backed by Hyundai, formally launched its commercial Atlas electric humanoid platform tailored for construction applications including site inspection, rebar carrying, and autonomous progress documentation using onboard LiDAR and vision. The robot leverages a reinforcement-learning locomotion stack enabling reliable traversal of uneven terrain, scaffolding, and staircases with loads up to 25 kg.
